records.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT co.country_region,ch.channel_desc,TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(s.amount_sold),2), 'FM999999999990.00') revenue FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN SH.countries co ON co.country_id=c.country_id JOIN SH.channels ch ON ch.channel_id=s.channel_id WHERE t.calendar_year=2000 GROUP BY co.country_region,ch.channel_desc ORDER BY SUM(s.amount_sold) DESC,co.country_region,ch.channel_desc) WHERE ROWNUM<=3

SELECT prod_category,prod_id,TO_CHAR(ROUND(revenue,2), 'FM999999999990.00') FROM (SELECT p.prod_category,p.prod_id,SUM(s.amount_sold) revenue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.prod_category ORDER BY SUM(s.amount_sold) DESC,p.prod_id) rn FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.products p ON p.prod_id=s.prod_id WHERE t.calendar_year=2001 GROUP BY p.prod_category,p.prod_id) WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY prod_category

SELECT ch.channel_desc,TO_CHAR(ROUND(100*(SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year=2001 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year=2000 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END))/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year=2000 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END),0),2), 'FM999999999990.00') FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.channels ch ON ch.channel_id=s.channel_id WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2000,2001) GROUP BY ch.channel_desc ORDER BY ch.channel_desc

SELECT prod_category,TO_CHAR(ROUND(100*revenue/SUM(revenue) OVER(),2), 'FM999999999990.00') FROM (SELECT p.prod_category,SUM(s.amount_sold) revenue FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.products p ON p.prod_id=s.prod_id WHERE t.calendar_year=1999 GROUP BY p.prod_category) ORDER BY prod_category

SELECT * FROM (SELECT co.country_name,COUNT(DISTINCT s.cust_id),TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(s.amount_sold)/COUNT(DISTINCT s.cust_id),2), 'FM999999999990.00') avg_revenue FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN SH.countries co ON co.country_id=c.country_id WHERE t.calendar_year=2000 GROUP BY co.country_name ORDER BY SUM(s.amount_sold)/COUNT(DISTINCT s.cust_id) DESC,co.country_name) WHERE ROWNUM<=3

SELECT calendar_quarter_number,channel_desc,TO_CHAR(ROUND(revenue,2), 'FM999999999990.00') FROM (SELECT t.calendar_quarter_number,ch.channel_id,ch.channel_desc,SUM(s.amount_sold) revenue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY t.calendar_quarter_number ORDER BY SUM(s.amount_sold) DESC,ch.channel_id) rn FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.channels ch ON ch.channel_id=s.channel_id WHERE t.calendar_year=2001 GROUP BY t.calendar_quarter_number,ch.channel_id,ch.channel_desc) WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY calendar_quarter_number

SELECT DISTINCT p.operation,p.options,p.object_name FROM v$sql_plan p JOIN v$sql s ON s.sql_id=p.sql_id AND s.child_number=p.child_number WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' AND (s.sql_id,s.child_number) IN (SELECT sql_id,child_number FROM v$sql WHERE parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND command_type=3 AND UPPER(sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' ORDER BY sql_id,child_number FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND p.object_owner='SHOPAPP' ORDER BY p.operation,p.options,p.object_name

SELECT DISTINCT p.operation,p.options,p.object_name FROM v$sql_plan p JOIN v$sql s ON s.sql_id=p.sql_id AND s.child_number=p.child_number WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT COUNT(%FROM SHOPAPP.ORDERS%' AND (s.sql_id,s.child_number) IN (SELECT sql_id,child_number FROM v$sql WHERE parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND command_type=3 AND UPPER(sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT COUNT(%FROM SHOPAPP.ORDERS%' ORDER BY sql_id,child_number FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND p.object_owner='SHOPAPP' ORDER BY p.operation,p.options,p.object_name

SELECT DISTINCT p.operation,p.options,p.object_name FROM v$sql_plan p JOIN v$sql s ON s.sql_id=p.sql_id AND s.child_number=p.child_number WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT COUNT(%FROM SHOPAPP.ORDER_LINES%' AND (s.sql_id,s.child_number) IN (SELECT sql_id,child_number FROM v$sql WHERE parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND command_type=3 AND UPPER(sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT COUNT(%FROM SHOPAPP.ORDER_LINES%' ORDER BY sql_id,child_number FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND p.object_owner='SHOPAPP' ORDER BY p.operation,p.options,p.object_name
SELECT event FROM v$system_event WHERE wait_class <> 'Idle' ORDER BY time_waited_micro DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT prod_category,TO_CHAR(ROUND(100*revenue/SUM(revenue) OVER(),2), 'FM999999999990.00') FROM (SELECT p.prod_category,SUM(s.amount_sold) revenue FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.products p ON p.prod_id=s.prod_id WHERE t.calendar_year=1999 GROUP BY p.prod_category) ORDER BY prod_category

SELECT DISTINCT p.operation,p.options,p.object_name FROM v$sql_plan p JOIN v$sql s ON s.sql_id=p.sql_id AND s.child_number=p.child_number WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' AND (s.sql_id,s.child_number) IN (SELECT sql_id,child_number FROM v$sql WHERE parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND command_type=3 AND UPPER(sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' ORDER BY sql_id,child_number FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND p.object_owner='SHOPAPP' ORDER BY p.operation,p.options,p.object_name

SELECT department_name FROM (SELECT d.department_name, AVG(e.salary) a FROM hr.employees e JOIN hr.departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY a DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT c.cust_last_name, TO_CHAR(SUM(o.order_total), 'FM999999999990.00') FROM oe.orders o JOIN oe.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.cust_last_name ORDER BY SUM(o.order_total) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT cc.column_name, r.table_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner = c.owner AND cc.constraint_name = c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints r ON r.owner = c.r_owner AND r.constraint_name = c.r_constraint_name WHERE c.owner = 'HR' AND c.table_name = 'EMPLOYEES' AND c.constraint_type = 'R'
SELECT wait_class FROM (SELECT wait_class, SUM(time_waited_micro) t FROM v$system_event WHERE wait_class <> 'Idle' GROUP BY wait_class ORDER BY t DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT 'CO','CUSTOMERS',COUNT(*) FROM co.customers UNION ALL SELECT 'OE','CUSTOMERS',COUNT(*) FROM oe.customers UNION ALL SELECT 'SH','CUSTOMERS',COUNT(*) FROM sh.customers
SELECT owner,column_name,data_type,nullable FROM all_tab_columns WHERE owner IN ('CO','OE') AND table_name='ORDERS' AND column_name LIKE '%STATUS%' ORDER BY owner,column_id
SELECT calendar_quarter_desc,MIN(fiscal_year),MAX(fiscal_year),COUNT(DISTINCT time_id) FROM sh.times WHERE calendar_year=2000 GROUP BY calendar_quarter_desc ORDER BY calendar_quarter_desc

SELECT p.id,NVL(TO_CHAR(p.parent_id),'ROOT'),p.depth,p.operation,NVL(p.options,'NONE') FROM v$sql_plan p WHERE (p.sql_id,p.child_number) IN (SELECT sql_id,child_number FROM v$sql WHERE UPPER(sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT /* P11_ORDER_PROBE */ ORDER_ID FROM SHOPAPP.ORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID = -110011%' ORDER BY sql_id,child_number FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) ORDER BY p.id
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN commission_pct IS NULL THEN 1 END),COUNT(CASE WHEN commission_pct=0 THEN 1 END),COUNT(CASE WHEN commission_pct>0 THEN 1 END) FROM hr.employees

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_constraints WHERE owner='SH' AND table_name='SALES' AND constraint_type='P' UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_constraints WHERE owner='SH' AND table_name='SALES' AND constraint_type='R'

SELECT cc.column_name,p.table_name,p.constraint_name,p.index_name,i.uniqueness,ic.column_position,ic.column_name,tc.data_type FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_indexes i ON i.owner=p.index_owner AND i.index_name=p.index_name JOIN all_ind_columns ic ON ic.index_owner=i.owner AND ic.index_name=i.index_name JOIN all_tab_columns tc ON tc.owner=ic.table_owner AND tc.table_name=ic.table_name AND tc.column_name=ic.column_name WHERE c.owner='SHOPAPP' AND c.table_name='ORDERS' AND c.constraint_type='R' AND p.table_name='CUSTOMERS' ORDER BY cc.position,ic.column_position

SELECT cc.column_name,p.owner,p.table_name,p.constraint_name,p.index_name,i.uniqueness,ic.column_position,ic.column_name,tc.data_type FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_indexes i ON i.owner=p.index_owner AND i.index_name=p.index_name JOIN all_ind_columns ic ON ic.index_owner=i.owner AND ic.index_name=i.index_name JOIN all_tab_columns tc ON tc.owner=ic.table_owner AND tc.table_name=ic.table_name AND tc.column_name=ic.column_name WHERE c.owner='OE' AND c.table_name='WAREHOUSES' AND c.constraint_type='R' ORDER BY cc.position,ic.column_position

SELECT d.department_id,d.department_name,r.n,r.salary_total,m.first_name||' '||m.last_name FROM (SELECT department_id,COUNT(*) n,SUM(salary) salary_total,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,department_id) rn FROM hr.employees WHERE department_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY department_id) r JOIN hr.departments d ON d.department_id=r.department_id JOIN hr.employees m ON m.employee_id=d.manager_id WHERE r.rn=2

SELECT w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,l.city,c.country_name,r.region_name FROM (SELECT warehouse_id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SUM(quantity_on_hand) DESC,warehouse_id) rn FROM oe.inventories GROUP BY warehouse_id) q JOIN oe.warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id=q.warehouse_id JOIN hr.locations l ON l.location_id=w.location_id JOIN hr.countries c ON c.country_id=l.country_id JOIN hr.regions r ON r.region_id=c.region_id WHERE q.rn=2
SELECT job_id,min_salary,max_salary FROM hr.jobs ORDER BY job_id
SELECT prod_subcategory,COUNT(*) FROM sh.products GROUP BY prod_subcategory ORDER BY prod_subcategory

SELECT o.order_mode,COUNT(*),ROUND(SUM(o.order_total),2),SUM(i.qty) FROM oe.orders o JOIN (SELECT order_id,SUM(quantity) qty FROM oe.order_items GROUP BY order_id) i ON i.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_mode ORDER BY o.order_mode

SELECT d.department_id,COUNT(e.employee_id),COUNT(e.manager_id),NVL(TO_CHAR(ROUND(AVG(e.manager_id),2),'FM9999990.00'),'NONE') FROM hr.departments d LEFT JOIN hr.employees e ON e.department_id=d.department_id WHERE d.location_id=1700 GROUP BY d.department_id ORDER BY d.department_id

SELECT manager_id,COUNT(*),COUNT(commission_pct),ROUND(AVG(commission_pct),4),ROUND(AVG(NVL(commission_pct,0)),4) FROM hr.employees WHERE manager_id IN (100,145) GROUP BY manager_id ORDER BY manager_id
SELECT employee_id,last_name,salary,rnk FROM (SELECT employee_id,last_name,salary,DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY salary DESC) rnk FROM hr.employees) WHERE rnk<=3 ORDER BY salary DESC,employee_id

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN order_date>=TIMESTAMP '2007-11-18 00:00:00' AND order_date<TIMESTAMP '2007-11-20 00:00:00' THEN 1 END),COUNT(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2007-11-18 00:00:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2007-11-19 00:00:00' THEN 1 END) FROM oe.orders

SELECT e.employee_id,TO_CHAR(h.start_date,'YYYY-MM-DD'),d.department_id,m.first_name||' '||m.last_name,j.job_title,l.city,c.country_name,r.region_name FROM (SELECT employee_id FROM hr.job_history GROUP BY employee_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,employee_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) e JOIN hr.job_history h ON h.employee_id=e.employee_id JOIN hr.departments d ON d.department_id=h.department_id JOIN hr.employees m ON m.employee_id=d.manager_id JOIN hr.jobs j ON j.job_id=m.job_id JOIN hr.locations l ON l.location_id=d.location_id JOIN hr.countries c ON c.country_id=l.country_id JOIN hr.regions r ON r.region_id=c.region_id ORDER BY h.start_date,h.end_date,h.job_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT s.sales_rep_id,ROUND(s.total,2),d.department_name,m.first_name||' '||m.last_name,j.job_title,c.country_name FROM (SELECT sales_rep_id,SUM(order_total) total FROM oe.orders WHERE sales_rep_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sales_rep_id ORDER BY total DESC,sales_rep_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) s JOIN hr.employees e ON e.employee_id=s.sales_rep_id JOIN hr.departments d ON d.department_id=e.department_id JOIN hr.employees m ON m.employee_id=d.manager_id JOIN hr.jobs j ON j.job_id=m.job_id JOIN hr.locations l ON l.location_id=d.location_id JOIN hr.countries c ON c.country_id=l.country_id
SELECT t.num_rows,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr.job_history),(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id) FROM hr.job_history) FROM all_tables t WHERE owner='HR' AND table_name='JOB_HISTORY'
SELECT instance_name FROM v$instance UNION ALL SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(version,'^[0-9]+') FROM v$instance
SELECT name FROM v$database UNION ALL SELECT open_mode FROM v$database
SELECT procedure_name FROM dba_procedures WHERE owner='SHOPAPP' AND object_name='WORKLOAD' AND procedure_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY procedure_name

SELECT (SELECT UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.text,'PROCEDURE +([a-z_]+)',1,1,'i',1)) FROM dba_source p WHERE p.owner=s.owner AND p.name=s.name AND p.type=s.type AND p.line=(SELECT MAX(h.line) FROM dba_source h WHERE h.owner=s.owner AND h.name=s.name AND h.type=s.type AND h.line<s.line AND REGEXP_LIKE(h.text,'PROCEDURE +','i'))) AS subprogram,UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.text,'(INSERT INTO|UPDATE|DELETE FROM) +([a-z_]+)',1,1,'i',2)) AS table_name,UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.text,'INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE',1,1,'i')) AS operation FROM dba_source s WHERE s.owner='SHOPAPP' AND s.name='WORKLOAD' AND s.type='PACKAGE BODY' AND REGEXP_LIKE(s.text,'^ *(INSERT INTO|UPDATE|DELETE FROM) ','i') ORDER BY s.line

SELECT UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(text,'DELETE FROM +([a-z_]+)',1,1,'i',1)) AS table_name FROM dba_source WHERE owner='SHOPAPP' AND name='WORKLOAD' AND type='PACKAGE BODY' AND REGEXP_LIKE(text,'^ *DELETE FROM','i') ORDER BY line

SELECT job_name,UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(job_action,'workload[.]([a-z_]+)',1,1,'i',1)) AS entry_point FROM dba_scheduler_jobs WHERE owner='SHOPAPP' AND LOWER(job_action) LIKE '%workload.%' ORDER BY job_name

SELECT 'CHILD' AS role,c.table_name AS table_name,cc.column_name AS column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.owner='SHOPAPP' AND c.constraint_name=(SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(additional_info,'SHOPAPP[.]([A-Z0-9_]+)',1,1,NULL,1) FROM dba_scheduler_job_run_details WHERE owner='SHOPAPP' AND job_name='NIGHTLY_PURGE_JOB' AND status='FAILED' ORDER BY log_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) UNION ALL SELECT 'PARENT' AS role,p.table_name AS table_name,pc.column_name AS column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.owner='SHOPAPP' AND c.constraint_name=(SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(additional_info,'SHOPAPP[.]([A-Z0-9_]+)',1,1,NULL,1) FROM dba_scheduler_job_run_details WHERE owner='SHOPAPP' AND job_name='NIGHTLY_PURGE_JOB' AND status='FAILED' ORDER BY log_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY)

SELECT fact FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(line) AS source_line,subprogram,operation,table_name FROM (SELECT s.line,UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(h.text,'PROCEDURE +([a-z_]+)',1,1,'i',1)) AS subprogram,UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.text,'DELETE',1,1,'i')) AS operation,UPPER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.text,'DELETE FROM +([a-z_]+)',1,1,'i',1)) AS table_name FROM dba_source s JOIN dba_source h ON h.owner=s.owner AND h.name=s.name AND h.type=s.type AND h.line=(SELECT MAX(x.line) FROM dba_source x WHERE x.owner=s.owner AND x.name=s.name AND x.type=s.type AND x.line<s.line AND REGEXP_LIKE(x.text,'PROCEDURE +','i')) WHERE s.owner='SHOPAPP' AND s.name='WORKLOAD' AND s.type='PACKAGE BODY' AND s.line=(SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(additional_info,'WORKLOAD", line ([0-9]+)',1,1,NULL,1)) FROM dba_scheduler_job_run_details WHERE owner='SHOPAPP' AND job_name='NIGHTLY_PURGE_JOB' AND status='FAILED' ORDER BY log_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY))) UNPIVOT (fact FOR item IN (source_line,subprogram,operation,table_name))

SELECT fact FROM (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(trigger_type,'^[A-Z]+') AS timing,REGEXP_SUBSTR(trigger_type,'ROW|STATEMENT') AS granularity,table_name,REGEXP_SUBSTR(triggering_event,'INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE',1,1) AS event1,REGEXP_SUBSTR(triggering_event,'INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE',1,2) AS event2,REGEXP_SUBSTR(triggering_event,'INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE',1,3) AS event3 FROM dba_triggers WHERE owner='HR' AND trigger_name='UPDATE_JOB_HISTORY') UNPIVOT (fact FOR item IN (timing,granularity,table_name,event1,event2,event3))

SELECT fact FROM (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(trigger_type,'^[A-Z]+') AS timing,REGEXP_SUBSTR(trigger_type,'ROW|STATEMENT') AS granularity,table_name,REGEXP_SUBSTR(triggering_event,'INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE',1,1) AS event1,REGEXP_SUBSTR(triggering_event,'INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE',1,2) AS event2,REGEXP_SUBSTR(triggering_event,'INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE',1,3) AS event3 FROM dba_triggers WHERE owner='HR' AND trigger_name='SECURE_EMPLOYEES') UNPIVOT (fact FOR item IN (timing,granularity,table_name,event1,event2,event3))
SELECT argument_name,position,in_out,data_type FROM dba_arguments WHERE owner='HR' AND object_name='ADD_JOB_HISTORY' AND package_name IS NULL ORDER BY sequence

SELECT status,'ORA-'||LPAD(TO_CHAR(error#),5,'0') AS error_code,REGEXP_SUBSTR(additional_info,'ORA-20001: ([^'||CHR(10)||']+)',1,1,NULL,1) AS message,TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(additional_info,'at line ([0-9]+)',1,1,NULL,1)) AS source_line FROM dba_scheduler_job_run_details WHERE owner='K7Q_OWNER' AND job_name='K7Q_FAILJOB' AND status='FAILED' ORDER BY log_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT 'ORA-' || LPAD(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT),'ORA-([0-9]{1,5})([^0-9]|$)',1,1,'c',1),5,'0') AS code, REGEXP_SUBSTR(MESSAGE_TEXT,'incident=([0-9]+)',1,1,'i',1) AS incident_id FROM V$DIAG_ALERT_EXT WHERE ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND MESSAGE_LEVEL=1 ORDER BY ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP DESC, RECORD_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT REPLACE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(MESSAGE_TEXT,'job ([^[:space:]]+)',1,1,'i',1),'"','') AS job_name, REGEXP_SUBSTR(MESSAGE_TEXT,'constraint [(]([^)]*)[)]',1,1,'i',1) AS constraint_name FROM V$DIAG_ALERT_EXT WHERE ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-05 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND INSTR(MESSAGE_TEXT,'ORA-12012')>0 AND INSTR(MESSAGE_TEXT,'ORA-02292')>0 ORDER BY job_name, constraint_name

SELECT p.PROBLEM_KEY AS problem_key, COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM V$DIAG_INCIDENT i JOIN V$DIAG_PROBLEM p ON p.PROBLEM_ID=i.PROBLEM_ID AND p.CON_ID=i.CON_ID WHERE i.CREATE_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND i.CREATE_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') GROUP BY p.PROBLEM_KEY ORDER BY p.PROBLEM_KEY

SELECT code FROM (SELECT code, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS frequency_rank FROM (SELECT 'ORA-' || LPAD(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT),'ORA-([0-9]{1,5})([^0-9]|$)',1,1,'c',1),5,'0') AS code FROM V$DIAG_ALERT_EXT WHERE ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT),'ORA-[0-9]{1,5}([^0-9]|$)')) WHERE code <> 'ORA-00000' GROUP BY code) WHERE frequency_rank=1 ORDER BY code

SELECT p.PROBLEM_KEY AS problem_key, COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM V$DIAG_INCIDENT i JOIN V$DIAG_PROBLEM p ON p.PROBLEM_ID=i.PROBLEM_ID AND p.CON_ID=i.CON_ID WHERE i.CREATE_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND i.CREATE_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') GROUP BY p.PROBLEM_KEY ORDER BY p.PROBLEM_KEY

SELECT code FROM (SELECT code, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS frequency_rank FROM (SELECT 'ORA-' || LPAD(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT),'ORA-([0-9]{1,5})([^0-9]|$)',1,1,'c',1),5,'0') AS code FROM V$DIAG_ALERT_EXT WHERE ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT),'ORA-[0-9]{1,5}([^0-9]|$)')) WHERE code <> 'ORA-00000' GROUP BY code) WHERE frequency_rank=1 ORDER BY code

SELECT s.plan_hash_value AS plan_hash_value, COUNT(*) AS child_count FROM v$sql s WHERE s.sql_id=(SELECT s.sql_id FROM v$sql s WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2027-01-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') ORDER BY s.sql_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) GROUP BY s.plan_hash_value ORDER BY s.plan_hash_value

SELECT DISTINCT t.owner AS owner, t.table_name AS object_name, NVL(t.stale_stats,'UNKNOWN') AS stale_stats, TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(CAST(t.last_analyzed AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') AT TIME ZONE '+00:00','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS last_analyzed_utc FROM dba_tab_statistics t JOIN v$sql_plan p ON p.object_owner=t.owner AND p.object_name=t.table_name WHERE p.sql_id=(SELECT s.sql_id FROM v$sql s WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2027-01-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') ORDER BY s.sql_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND t.object_type='TABLE' UNION SELECT DISTINCT i.owner AS owner, i.index_name AS object_name, NVL(i.stale_stats,'UNKNOWN') AS stale_stats, TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(CAST(i.last_analyzed AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') AT TIME ZONE '+00:00','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS last_analyzed_utc FROM dba_ind_statistics i JOIN v$sql_plan p ON p.object_owner=i.owner AND p.object_name=i.index_name WHERE p.sql_id=(SELECT s.sql_id FROM v$sql s WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2027-01-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') ORDER BY s.sql_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND i.object_type='INDEX' ORDER BY owner, object_name

SELECT b.name AS bind_name, b.position AS position, b.datatype_string AS datatype, b.was_captured AS was_captured FROM v$sql_bind_capture b WHERE (b.sql_id,b.child_number) IN (SELECT s.sql_id,s.child_number FROM v$sql s WHERE s.sql_id=(SELECT s.sql_id FROM v$sql s WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2027-01-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') ORDER BY s.sql_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) ORDER BY s.child_number FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) ORDER BY b.position

SELECT s.sql_id AS sql_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.sql_plan_baseline) AS attached_baseline_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.sql_profile) AS attached_profile_count FROM v$sql s WHERE s.sql_id=(SELECT s.sql_id FROM v$sql s WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2027-01-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') ORDER BY s.sql_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) GROUP BY s.sql_id
SELECT u.username AS username FROM dba_users u JOIN dba_users_with_defpwd d ON d.username=u.username WHERE u.account_status='OPEN' ORDER BY u.username

SELECT DISTINCT r.granted_role AS granting_role, r.role_depth AS role_depth, p.privilege AS privilege FROM (SELECT granted_role, LEVEL AS role_depth FROM dba_role_privs START WITH grantee='HARNESS_APP' CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR granted_role=grantee AND LEVEL<=10) r JOIN dba_sys_privs p ON p.grantee=r.granted_role WHERE INSTR(' ' || p.privilege || ' ',' ANY ')>0 ORDER BY granting_role, role_depth, privilege

SELECT grantee AS grantee, owner AS owner, table_name AS object_name, privilege AS privilege FROM dba_tab_privs WHERE grantee='PUBLIC' AND owner='SYS' AND table_name='UTL'||'_FILE' AND privilege='EXECUTE' ORDER BY grantee, owner, table_name, privilege

SELECT p.profile AS profile, p.limit AS stored_limit, CASE WHEN p.limit='DEFAULT' THEN d.limit ELSE p.limit END AS effective_limit FROM dba_profiles p JOIN dba_profiles d ON d.profile='DEFAULT' AND d.resource_name=p.resource_name AND d.resource_type=p.resource_type WHERE p.profile='GSM_PROF' AND p.resource_name='PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME'

SELECT resource_name AS resource_name, limit AS configured_limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE profile='DEFAULT' AND resource_type='PASSWORD' AND resource_name IN ('FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS','PASSWORD_LIFE_TIME','PASSWORD_VERIFY_FUNCTION') ORDER BY resource_name

SELECT policy_name AS policy_name, enabled_option AS enabled_option, entity_name AS entity_name, entity_type AS entity_type, success AS success, failure AS failure FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies ORDER BY policy_name, entity_name, entity_type, enabled_option, success, failure
SELECT argument_name AS argument_name, defaulted AS defaulted FROM dba_arguments WHERE owner='HR' AND object_name='ADD_JOB_HISTORY' AND package_name IS NULL ORDER BY sequence
SELECT trigger_name AS trigger_name,status AS status,trigger_type AS trigger_type FROM dba_triggers WHERE owner='HR' AND table_name='EMPLOYEES' ORDER BY trigger_name
SELECT object_type AS object_type,status AS status FROM dba_objects WHERE owner='SHOPAPP' AND object_name='WORKLOAD' AND object_type IN ('PACKAGE','PACKAGE BODY') ORDER BY object_type

SELECT MIN(incident_id) AS first_id,MAX(incident_id) AS last_id,COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM v$diag_incident WHERE create_time>=TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD TZH:TZM') AND create_time<TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD TZH:TZM')

SELECT message_level AS message_level,COUNT(*) AS message_count FROM v$diag_alert_ext WHERE originating_timestamp>=TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD TZH:TZM') AND originating_timestamp<TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-05 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD TZH:TZM') GROUP BY message_level ORDER BY message_level
SELECT problem_id AS problem_id,problem_key AS problem_key FROM v$diag_problem ORDER BY problem_id
SELECT index_name AS index_name,uniqueness AS uniqueness,status AS status FROM all_indexes WHERE table_owner='SHOPAPP' AND table_name='PRODUCTS' ORDER BY index_name
SELECT NVL(stale_stats,'UNKNOWN') AS stale_stats,global_stats AS global_stats FROM dba_tab_statistics WHERE owner='SHOPAPP' AND table_name='PRODUCTS' AND object_type='TABLE'

SELECT DISTINCT p.operation AS operation,NVL(p.options,'NONE') AS options FROM v$sql_plan p JOIN v$sql s ON s.sql_id=p.sql_id AND s.child_number=p.child_number WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' ORDER BY operation,options
SELECT resource_name AS resource_name,limit AS configured_limit FROM dba_profiles WHERE profile='DEFAULT' AND resource_name IN ('PASSWORD_LOCK_TIME','PASSWORD_GRACE_TIME') ORDER BY resource_name
SELECT policy_name AS policy_name,success AS success,failure AS failure FROM audit_unified_enabled_policies ORDER BY policy_name,success,failure

SELECT message_level AS message_level,COUNT(*) AS message_count FROM v$diag_alert_ext WHERE originating_timestamp>=TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD TZH:TZM') AND originating_timestamp<TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD TZH:TZM') GROUP BY message_level ORDER BY message_level
SELECT problem_id AS problem_id,problem_key AS problem_key,last_incident AS last_incident FROM v$diag_problem ORDER BY problem_id
SELECT wait_class AS wait_class FROM v$system_event WHERE wait_class <> 'Idle' GROUP BY wait_class ORDER BY SUM(time_waited_micro) DESC, wait_class FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT wait_class AS wait_class FROM v$system_event WHERE wait_class <> 'Idle' GROUP BY wait_class ORDER BY SUM(time_waited_micro) DESC, wait_class FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT name AS event_name, wait_class AS wait_class FROM v$event_name WHERE name IN ('log file sync','log file parallel write') ORDER BY name
SELECT name AS event_name, wait_class AS wait_class FROM v$event_name WHERE name IN ('enq: TX - row lock contention','enq: TM - contention','SQL*Net message from client') ORDER BY name
SELECT wait_class AS wait_class, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM v$event_name WHERE wait_class IN ('Application','Commit','Concurrency') GROUP BY wait_class ORDER BY wait_class
SELECT wait_class AS wait_class, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM v$event_name WHERE wait_class IN ('User I/O','System I/O','Idle') GROUP BY wait_class ORDER BY wait_class

SELECT owner AS owner, segment_name AS segment_name, segment_type AS segment_type, NVL(partition_name, 'NONE') AS partition_name FROM dba_segments WHERE owner = 'SHOPAPP' ORDER BY bytes DESC, segment_name, partition_name NULLS FIRST, segment_type FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT t.tablespace_name AS tablespace_name, SUM(CASE WHEN f.autoextensible = 'YES' THEN GREATEST(f.bytes, f.maxbytes) ELSE f.bytes END) AS maximum_bytes FROM dba_tablespaces t JOIN dba_data_files f ON f.tablespace_name = t.tablespace_name WHERE t.contents = 'PERMANENT' GROUP BY t.tablespace_name ORDER BY t.tablespace_name
SELECT thread# AS thread_number, group# AS group_number, bytes AS size_bytes, members AS member_count FROM v$log ORDER BY thread#, group#
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 OR NVL(MAX(space_limit), 0) = 0 THEN 'NOT CONFIGURED' ELSE 'CONFIGURED' END AS configuration, NVL(MAX(space_limit), 0) AS limit_bytes FROM v$recovery_file_dest

SELECT t.tablespace_name AS tablespace_name, r.value AS retention_seconds, t.retention AS retention_guarantee FROM v$parameter u JOIN dba_tablespaces t ON t.tablespace_name = u.value CROSS JOIN v$parameter r WHERE u.name = 'undo_tablespace' AND r.name = 'undo_retention'

SELECT s.owner AS owner, s.segment_name AS segment_name, l.table_name AS table_name, l.column_name AS column_name FROM dba_segments s JOIN dba_lobs l ON l.owner = s.owner AND l.segment_name = s.segment_name JOIN dba_users u ON u.username = s.owner WHERE s.segment_type = 'LOBSEGMENT' AND u.oracle_maintained = 'N' ORDER BY s.bytes DESC, s.owner, s.segment_name FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT NVL(TO_CHAR(MAX(completion_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'NONE RECORDED') AS last_level_0 FROM v$backup_datafile WHERE incremental_level = 0 AND file# > 0

SELECT CASE WHEN b.last_l0 IS NULL THEN 'NO LEVEL 0 RECORDED' ELSE 'RECORDED INTERIOR GAPS ONLY' END AS coverage, CASE WHEN b.last_l0 IS NULL THEN 'NOT VERIFIABLE' ELSE TO_CHAR(NVL(g.missing_sequences, 0), 'FM99999999999999999990') END AS gap_count FROM (SELECT MAX(completion_time) AS last_l0 FROM v$backup_datafile WHERE incremental_level = 0 AND file# > 0 AND resetlogs_change# = (SELECT resetlogs_change# FROM v$database)) b CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(GREATEST(sequence# - previous_sequence - 1, 0)) AS missing_sequences FROM (SELECT thread#, sequence#, LAG(sequence#) OVER (PARTITION BY thread# ORDER BY sequence#) AS previous_sequence FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.thread#, a.sequence# FROM v$archived_log a CROSS JOIN v$database d WHERE a.resetlogs_change# = d.resetlogs_change# AND a.archived = 'YES' AND a.next_time > (SELECT MAX(completion_time) FROM v$backup_datafile WHERE incremental_level = 0 AND file# > 0 AND resetlogs_change# = (SELECT resetlogs_change# FROM v$database))))) g

SELECT 'RETENTION POLICY' AS setting_name, NVL(MAX(value), 'NOT EXPLICITLY CONFIGURED') AS stored_setting, NVL(MAX(value), 'REDUNDANCY 1') AS policy FROM v$rman_configuration WHERE name = 'RETENTION POLICY'

SELECT 'RMAN job history' AS category, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM v$rman_backup_job_details UNION ALL SELECT 'Datafile backups', COUNT(*) FROM v$backup_datafile UNION ALL SELECT 'Backup sets', COUNT(*) FROM v$backup_set UNION ALL SELECT 'Backup pieces', COUNT(*) FROM v$backup_piece

SELECT v.view_name, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_tab_privs WHERE table_schema='SYS' AND table_name=REPLACE(v.view_name,'V$','V_$') AND privilege='SELECT' AND grantee IN (SELECT role FROM session_roles UNION ALL SELECT USER FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'PUBLIC' FROM dual))=0 THEN 'unavailable' ELSE 'available' END FROM (SELECT 'V$SGA_DYNAMIC_COMPONENTS' view_name FROM dual) v ORDER BY v.view_name

SELECT NVL(MAX(job_name) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY log_date, log_id), 'NONE RECORDED') AS job_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'NO ERROR RECORDED' ELSE 'ORA-' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(MAX(error#) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY log_date, log_id)), 5, '0') END AS error_code FROM dba_scheduler_job_run_details WHERE owner = 'SHOPAPP' AND status = 'FAILED'
SELECT 'SHOPAPP' AS owner, COUNT(*) AS invalid_objects FROM dba_objects WHERE owner = 'SHOPAPP' AND status = 'INVALID'
SELECT client_name, status FROM dba_autotask_client WHERE client_name = 'auto optimizer stats collection'
SELECT enabled, CASE WHEN next_run_date IS NULL THEN 'NOT RECORDED' ELSE 'PRESENT' END AS next_run FROM dba_scheduler_jobs WHERE owner = 'SHOPAPP' AND job_name = 'NIGHTLY_PURGE_JOB'
SELECT UPPER(name), value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sga_target','pga_aggregate_target') ORDER BY name

SELECT v.view_name, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_tab_privs WHERE table_schema='SYS' AND table_name=REPLACE(v.view_name,'V$','V_$') AND privilege='SELECT' AND grantee IN (SELECT role FROM session_roles UNION ALL SELECT USER FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'PUBLIC' FROM dual))=0 THEN 'unavailable' ELSE 'available' END FROM (SELECT 'V$SGASTAT' view_name FROM dual) v ORDER BY v.view_name

SELECT p.table_name, pc.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name WHERE c.owner='SH' AND c.table_name='SALES' AND c.constraint_name='SALES_PROMO_FK' AND c.constraint_type='R'
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 'does not exist' ELSE 'exists' END FROM all_tables WHERE owner='SH' AND table_name='SALES_ARCHIVE_2099'
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(s.amount_sold),2),'FM999999999990.00') FROM sh.sales s JOIN sh.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year=1998
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(s.amount_sold),2),'FM999999999990.00') FROM sh.sales s JOIN sh.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year=2000
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(s.amount_sold),2),'FM999999999990.00') FROM sh.sales s JOIN sh.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year=1999
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(s.amount_sold),2),'FM999999999990.00') FROM sh.sales s JOIN sh.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id WHERE t.calendar_year=2001
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1073741824,6),'FM999999990.000000') FROM dba_segments WHERE owner='SH' AND segment_name='SALES' AND segment_type IN ('TABLE','TABLE PARTITION','TABLE SUBPARTITION')
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1048576,2),'FM999999990.00') FROM dba_segments WHERE owner='SH' AND segment_name='CUSTOMERS' AND segment_type IN ('TABLE','TABLE PARTITION','TABLE SUBPARTITION')
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1073741824,6),'FM999999990.000000') FROM dba_segments WHERE owner='SH' AND segment_name='COSTS' AND segment_type IN ('TABLE','TABLE PARTITION','TABLE SUBPARTITION')
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1048576,4),'FM999999990.0000') FROM dba_segments WHERE owner='SH' AND segment_name='PRODUCTS' AND segment_type IN ('TABLE','TABLE PARTITION','TABLE SUBPARTITION')

SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.store_name,o.order_status,COUNT(*) order_count FROM co.orders o JOIN co.stores s ON s.store_id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.store_name,o.order_status HAVING COUNT(*)>=100 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,s.store_name,o.order_status) WHERE ROWNUM<=3

SELECT warehouse_name,product_count,TO_CHAR(ROUND(stock_value,2),'FM999999999990.00') FROM (SELECT w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name,COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) product_count,SUM(i.quantity_on_hand*p.list_price) stock_value FROM oe.inventories i JOIN oe.warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id JOIN oe.product_information p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.quantity_on_hand>0 AND p.list_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_name ORDER BY stock_value DESC,w.warehouse_id) WHERE ROWNUM<=3

SELECT DISTINCT p.operation,p.options,p.object_name FROM v$sql_plan p JOIN v$sql s ON s.sql_id=p.sql_id AND s.child_number=p.child_number WHERE (s.sql_id,s.child_number) IN (SELECT sql_id,child_number FROM v$sql WHERE command_type=3 AND UPPER(sql_text)='SELECT JOB_ID,MAX_SALARY FROM HR.JOBS WHERE MAX_SALARY>12000' ORDER BY sql_id,child_number FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND p.object_owner='HR' ORDER BY p.operation,p.options,p.object_name
SELECT job_id,TO_CHAR(ROUND(AVG(end_date-start_date),2),'FM999999990.00') FROM hr.job_history GROUP BY job_id ORDER BY job_id

SELECT v.view_name, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_tab_privs WHERE table_schema='SYS' AND table_name=REPLACE(v.view_name,'V$','V_$') AND privilege='SELECT' AND grantee IN (SELECT role FROM session_roles UNION ALL SELECT USER FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'PUBLIC' FROM dual))=0 THEN 'unavailable' ELSE 'available' END FROM (SELECT 'V$SGASTAT' view_name FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'V$SGA_DYNAMIC_COMPONENTS' view_name FROM dual) v ORDER BY v.view_name
SELECT column_name,data_type,data_length FROM all_tab_columns WHERE owner='OE' AND table_name='PRODUCT_DESCRIPTIONS' AND column_name LIKE 'LANG%'
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(unit_price*quantity),2),'FM999999999990.00') FROM oe.order_items

SELECT c.table_name,cc.column_name,p.table_name,pc.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.owner='HR' AND c.table_name IN ('LOCATIONS','COUNTRIES') AND c.constraint_type='R' ORDER BY c.table_name,cc.position
SELECT TO_CHAR(ROUND(SUM(bytes)/1000000,6),'FM999999990.000000') FROM dba_segments WHERE owner='HR' AND segment_name='JOBS' AND segment_type IN ('TABLE','TABLE PARTITION','TABLE SUBPARTITION')

SELECT c.table_name,cc.column_name,p.table_name,pc.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.owner='SHOPAPP' AND c.constraint_type='R' ORDER BY c.table_name,cc.position

SELECT c.constraint_name,c.index_name,ic.column_position,ic.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_ind_columns ic ON ic.index_owner=c.index_owner AND ic.index_name=c.index_name WHERE c.owner='SHOPAPP' AND c.table_name='ORDER_LINES' AND c.constraint_type='P' ORDER BY ic.column_position

SELECT cc.column_name,p.table_name,pc.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.owner='SH' AND c.table_name='SALES' AND c.constraint_type='R' ORDER BY cc.column_name
